sarah: Quick sync — posting RCA actions for INC-2026. Need final owners + firm due dates by EOD Wed. Please ack and update the actions sheet.
javier: I can own action #3 (kv-cache eviction mitigation). Target: EOD Tue. Blocker: we need a prod key rotation window. @priya can you confirm infra availability?
priya: @javier we have a 2hr maintenance window Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Thu is freer for infra changes though. :thinking_face:
javier: Thu works for me. I'll move the due-date to Thu 06/20 and note the window. Sheet link: https://go/sheets/INC-2026-actions
sarah: thanks. Please put your Slack handle in the "owner" column so downstream teams can ping you directly.
dave: I'll take action #7 (model fallback rule + canary). Due 2024-06-25. Small PR open: https://git/repo/pull/424 — needs review from @javier for rollout infra.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 2024-06-20 06:30 UTC — status: scheduled
sarah: Two quick formatting asks for the sheet:
1) owner should be Slack handle (eg `@javier`)
2) add a one-line test plan snippet. Example row to copy:
```
INC-2026 | #3 | @javier | 2024-06-20 | migrate key, run staging smoke, verify KV eviction behaviour
```
priya: Done — updated owner + added test plan for #3.
sarah: ACK. @dave please add the canary metrics you care about (latency p95, error-rate, tail mem) in the sheet and tag any downstream teams.
dave: Added metrics + pinged data-platform for alert thresholds.
sarah: Great. I'll loop in PM and security to confirm the window. If anyone cannot hit these dates, reply here now so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
javier: ack :thumbsup:
priya: ack :eyes:
